The nod from the left-leaning standard bearer and the backing of the Working Families Party, however, were unable to make up the difference, as Brannan also lagged Levine in fundraising. While Brannan won Brooklyn, Levine handily won Manhattan, Queens and the Bronx. Levine will now compete in the November general election, where he’s expected to cruise to victory.
